measurementPolicy.meaning: Evidence-backed end-to-end readiness for a fully working, private, tested, hardened Remote Joining experience.
measurementPolicy.increaseRule: Increase only when new verified evidence materially improves an existing fixed capability domain.
measurementPolicy.decreaseRule: Decrease only when previously credited capability evidence is invalidated or a proven regression removes capability.
measurementPolicy.modelChangeRule: Changing domain weights or the denominator requires a new modelVersion, explicit rationale and backcast of prior comparable scores.
measurementPolicy.reportingRule: Every substantive owner-facing development checkpoint reports the latest calculated score even when it does not change.

domains.label: Devices, pairing, Connected Rivalry and actual Remote Joining
evidence: Remote schema and two-owner governance contracts reserve device, invite, session and rivalry identities.

2026-08-24 owner-supplied evidence from a second independent production rivalry on iPhone proves an unrefreshed Player One publish cannot overwrite Player Two's newly created authoritative revision 0: the runtime rejects the stale base and reports that local saves were not changed.

The same iPhone production sequence then proves deterministic recovery and convergence: Player One refreshes after rejection to revision 0, publishes exactly once through the CAS update path to monotonic revision 1, and Player Two refreshes that same revision 1 without local Apply or a reported local-save overwrite.

2026-08-25/26 owner Chromebook production proof on v1.8.1-r3 closes the previously uncredited remote-to-local reconciliation capability: read-only exact revision/hash Preview, stale-intent rejection before backup/local mutation, verified backup-first explicit Candidate C Apply, stable Player Two identity, exact local convergence to revision 1, and unchanged remote revision/hash after local Apply.

2026-08-26 permanent Stage 4 emulator proof executes the real Connected Rivalry mutation runtime against production Firestore Rules and closes exact accepted-result idempotency replay: after the rivalry legitimately advances from revision 0 to revision 1, replay of the exact original accepted request returns the original revision 0/hash while current authority, receipt set, canonical local Save snapshot, CAS and two-owner boundaries remain unchanged.

2026-08-26 permanent adverse-network contract executes the real Connected Rivalry client API through provider loss after valid registered-device/exactly-two-owner preflight and immutable local projection planning, proving bounded failure with the canonical local Save Library snapshot unchanged.

Authenticated third-account/revoked-device production negatives, two-physical-network hardening and actual Remote Joining sessions remain uncredited. Token-lifecycle safety is credited separately in production-cloud-security and does not add duplicate Connected Rivalry credit.

2026-08-31 PR #173 permanently executes the separate Stage 5A private-session client against isolated candidate Firestore Rules in the real emulator: exact 256-bit capability/no listing, host-open, entitled-peer join, deterministic replay, immutable lifecycle/expiry/membership, terminal no-resurrection and account/entitlement/provider-device-credential denial all pass. Reads and writes require a provider-verifiable active device_id token claim; missing, never-registered, revoked and mismatched credentials fail closed. Production does not issue that claim and the client/Rules remain dormant/unpublished, so this is delta 0 until the provider credential, minimum Rules and actual production host/join capability are separately live and proven.
